body: ### What are you really trying to do? Report custom metrics when tracing is enabled ### Describe the bug When using the @temporalio/interceptors-opentelemetry plugin and have tracing enabled, trace_id/span_id are added to custom metrics which leads to unbounded cardinality ### Minimal Reproduction Add a custom metric to the interceptor sample: https://github.com/andrewspinks/samples-typescript/commit/d7dfb284d6102366a3332502416f38c650825537 Example metrics exported: ### Environment/Versions sdk-typescript: 1.18.0 ### Additional context

comments.body: Fix released in [1.18.1](https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-typescript/releases/tag/v1.18.1) and published to NPM

title: [Bug] Otel interceptor adds trace_id/span_id to custom metrics
